## Summary: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio

**Alibaba Cloud Model Studio** is a one-stop, enterprise-grade model service and AI application development platform. Key points from the official documentation:

- **Model access**: Provides the full Qwen series plus mainstream third-party LLMs (e.g., DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM) through official Qwen APIs — no infrastructure to manage, with pay-as-you-go, on-demand usage.
- **Flagship tiers**: Qwen-Max (highest performance for complex multi-step tasks), Qwen-Plus (balanced performance/speed/cost, recommended for most scenarios), and Qwen-Flash (low-cost, low-latency for simple tasks).
- **Multimodal support**: Text generation, visual understanding, image generation, video generation (Wan series), speech recognition/synthesis, and embeddings.
- **OpenAI compatibility**: Drop-in migration for existing OpenAI code — just update the API key, base URL, and model name.
- **Domain-specific models**: For long-text processing, translation, data mining, intent recognition, role-playing, and deep research.
- **GenAI applications**: Includes AI-native tools such as QwenWork (productivity platform) and Qoder (AI coding assistant with enterprise deployment options).

**Source**: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/what-is-model-studio

Related official docs: [API Reference](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/model-api-reference/), [Supported Models Overview](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/models), and [Getting Started](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/get-started-with-models/).
